about: A terminal with no running pane (ov-191): AgentKit's LostPaneTests and Android's LostPaneTest both replay every case, whole strings, so a sentence changed on one side and not the other fails on the side left behind.

kinds.title: Terminal Lost
kinds.explanation: Its tmux pane is gone. The pane was closed outside Far Cooler, tmux was quit, or the runner restarted. Nothing is running in it now.
kinds.shell_message: Its tmux pane is gone. The pane was closed outside Far Cooler, tmux was quit, or the runner restarted. Nothing is running in it now. Restart opens a new shell in this worktree. What was running in it wasn’t recorded, so you’ll need to start that again. Dismiss removes it from the list.

kinds.title: Terminal Ended
kinds.explanation: Its program ended. Nothing is running in it now.
kinds.shell_message: Its program ended. Nothing is running in it now. Restart opens a new shell in this worktree. What was running in it wasn’t recorded, so you’ll need to start that again.

kinds.title: Terminal Didn’t Start
kinds.shell_message: The runner couldn’t start it. Restart opens a new shell in this worktree. What was running in it wasn’t recorded, so you’ll need to start that again.
